# Sylvie · Guide Château de Voltaire

> Guided tours of the Château de Voltaire and Ferney-Voltaire, an easy day trip from Geneva. Private guide Sylvie leads tours in English, French, German, Russian.

Sylvie is an accredited guide at the Château de Voltaire in Ferney-Voltaire (France), working with the château for more than 8 years. Tours in French, English, German and Russian; every visit includes Voltaire's gardens. 15 minutes from Geneva Airport and Palexpo, TPG bus lines 60/61, coach parking on site. Prices cover the guiding fee only; the château admission is paid on site.

- [Voltaire Castle Tours from Geneva | Groups & Private Tours](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/tours/): Private tour of the Castle of Voltaire, group and themed tours, team building and school visits: guided tours of Ferney-Voltaire, a short trip from Geneva.
- [Prices & booking — Château de Voltaire guided tours](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/prices/): Prices for Sylvie's guided tours of the Château de Voltaire: classic, private, group, Saturday market and thematic visits. Choose, see your total, book.
- [Group Tours Château de Voltaire | Group Booking & Guided Visits](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/group-tours/): Group booking for guided visits of the Château de Voltaire in Ferney-Voltaire: tourist groups, companies, senior clubs, schools and associations near Geneva.
- [Corporate Group Tours & Team Outings | Château de Voltaire (Near Geneva)](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/group-tours/corporate-groups/): Corporate group tours, team building and incentives at Voltaire’s château in Ferney-Voltaire, on the Geneva border. Private group visits in 4 languages.
- [Senior & Association Group Tours | Château de Voltaire (Accessible)](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/group-tours/senior-groups/): Accessible guided tour of the Château de Voltaire for senior groups and associations: gentle pace, seated breaks, coach parking. A cultural outing near Geneva.
- [Enlightenment & Literary Tours | Château de Voltaire, Ferney](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/thematic-tours/): Thematic guided tours in Ferney-Voltaire: Enlightenment history, Voltaire and Geneva, literary tours of the Château de Voltaire, château life and gardens.
- [Voltaire in Ferney: Biography, Quotes and His Château](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/voltaire/): Who was Voltaire? His life in key dates, famous quotes and the story of the Château de Voltaire in Ferney, where the philosopher lived for nearly twenty years.
- [About Sylvie, Official Guide at the Château de Voltaire](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/about/): Meet Sylvie, a passionate official guide at Voltaire’s château in Ferney: a storyteller who brings Voltaire and the Enlightenment to life in four languages.
- [Château de Voltaire Photo Gallery | Tours with Sylvie](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/en/gallery/): Photos of the Château de Voltaire, its park and hornbeam walks, and guided tours with Sylvie in Ferney-Voltaire near Geneva.

- [Visites seniors et associations | Château de Voltaire accessible](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/fr/visites-de-groupe/seniors/): Visite guidée accessible du Château de Voltaire pour groupes seniors et associations : rythme doux, pauses assises, parking autocars. Près de Genève.
- [Visites thématiques Lumières & littérature | Château de Voltaire](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/fr/visites-thematiques/): Visites guidées thématiques à Ferney-Voltaire : histoire des Lumières, Voltaire et Genève, visite littéraire du Château de Voltaire, vie au château et jardins.
- [Voltaire à Ferney : biographie, citations et château](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/fr/voltaire/): Qui était Voltaire ? Biographie, dates clés, citations célèbres et histoire du Château de Voltaire à Ferney, où le philosophe vécut près de vingt ans.
- [Sylvie, guide officielle au Château de Voltaire, Ferney](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/fr/a-propos/): Découvrez Sylvie, guide officielle passionnée au Château de Voltaire : une conteuse qui fait revivre Voltaire et les Lumières en quatre langues.
- [Galerie photos du Château de Voltaire | Sylvie, guide](https://www.guidevoltaire.com/fr/galerie/): Photos du Château de Voltaire, de son parc, de ses charmilles et des visites guidées avec Sylvie à Ferney-Voltaire.
